resources.string: Fix washed-out colors on some devices. May slightly reduce performance.

Needed to show your recordings and screenshots in the app (including files saved before you reinstalled CatRec). If Android offers only partial access, choose allow all or include Movies/CatRec and Pictures/CatRec/Screenshots.

string-array.name: changelog_v112_items

string-array.name: changelog_v110_items
